C0820.title: Verizon DBIR 2023 Highlights Credential Abuse and Ransomware as Major Breach Risks
C0820.summary: Verizon's 2023 Data Breach Investigations Report states that financial motivation continued to dominate data breaches, the use of stolen credentials remained a prominent breach path, and ransomware was still an important cross-industry threat. The report also discusses cryptocurrency theft, ransomware, and data theft extortion, showing how credential abuse can support follow-on intrusion, extortion, and asset theft.
